column1: # decision-telemetry-v1
# WHAT WAS CHOSEN, WHY, WHAT IT COST, AND WHAT HAPPENED. One row per decision.
# Written only by build-os/metrics/record-decision.sh, which refuses a row this
# store cannot later be trusted about.
# AN UNKNOWN IS NOT A ZERO, AND THAT IS THE WHOLE POINT OF THE COLUMN FORMAT.
# Every quantitative field is either the literal `unknown` or `<value>@<provenance>`
# with provenance in measured / derived / reported. A BARE NUMBER IS REFUSED.
# Omitting a field yields `unknown`, never 0, so the easy path is the honest one.
# `0@measured` is legal and means something completely different from `unknown`:
# zero fix rounds is a measurement, and nobody having counted is not.
# NOTHING HERE WAS BACK-FILLED BY INFERENCE. The historical rows carry `unknown`
# in almost every quantitative column because those quantities were never
# measured. The two exceptions are DECISION-0001's wall_minutes and
# serial_minutes, marked `@derived`, and the derivation is stated so it is
# reproducible: they are copied from build-os/metrics/packet_metrics.tsv's
# `wall_min` and `serial_min` columns for the packet
# `gravito_fanout_lanes_scaffold_release_a`, which is the only historical packet
# whose row carries them. Every other packet's row records `-` in those columns,
# and that store's own note says they "were never recorded and are left empty
# rather than reconstructed from commit timestamps". That judgement is inherited
# here rather than quietly reversed.
# THE `defect_classes_*` COLUMNS reference DEFECT-* ids from
# build-os/registry/defect_classes.txt, `;`-separated. They record what was
# DETECTED and what ESCAPED at the packet's gates, migrated from the receipts —
# which is why they too are `unknown` wherever the receipt does not say.
# `selector` records WHO CHOSE, and it is not decoration: DECISION-0007 was
# selected by the operator against the only ordering signal that existed, and a
# later evaluation of whether the signals are worth having needs to know that the
# signal was overruled rather than absent.

column1: DECISION-0008-p2-claim-scoped-evidence
column6: the operator's five-phase sequence named P2, and the only candidate that can represent the canonical fixture WITHOUT either widening a closed field list or introducing an exit-2 path that owns no registry entry is the separate store. It was ALSO the most expensive on the one signal that ranks cost: it is the only arm with census_growth_controls > 0 (3), so the selection went against the cheap signal rather than with it.
column7: a control can carry opposed verdicts on different claims without either collapsing the other; the legacy empirical_status field stays readable through a deterministic composite that cannot drop a refutation or raise a licence

column1: DECISION-0009-p3-accept-and-constrain
column6: the operator's five-phase sequence named P3, and a standing residue ruling assigns expiry enforcement to the same packet, so the two arms that split them (PACKET-0025, PACKET-0026) each leave a named obligation open. PACKET-0024 was the cheap arm on the only signal that ranks cost — census_growth_controls 0 against the selected arm's 4 — and it was rejected because a disposition field on control_registry.txt requires widening a CLOSED field list whose every-field-present check would fail all 97 entries, and because a field has no validator that can REFUSE a non-qualifying subject, so the maint.source_scan_mask discipline test would not be representable at all. THE SELECTION WENT AGAINST THE CHEAP SIGNAL: the chosen arm is the MOST expensive of the four on census growth, and it is the only one that scores 1 on both residue_ruling_satisfied and discriminating_negative_fixture_representable
column7: a fifth disposition exists, is applied to exactly ONE control, refuses its neighbour by name with the census's own words, and clears no mismatch; and an authority envelope outside its lease term contributes no grant in either direction, reported LAPSED or NOT-YET-LIVE, with the clock overridable and announced

column1: DECISION-0010-p4-s1-shadow-ranker
column6: SELECTED BEFORE S1 EXISTED, WHICH IS WHAT MAKES rank_of_selected NON-CIRCULAR. The re-cut was endorsed by the reviewer at the gravito_p3_accept_and_constrain_a close and staged in build-os/packets/active_packet.md as the contract's own remedy for a fourth serial stage; it is the only candidate in the set that a standing ruling names as NEXT rather than as queued. S1 ranked this set afterwards and consumed nothing: it holds runtime_authority observe, it wrote no row here, and no policy in this repository reads its ordering.
column7: the five counts stated in two places across residue (hhh)-(lll) are DERIVED rather than restated, closing the counts half of DEFECT-0003-duplicate-semantic-truth that P3 left to hand

column1: DECISION-0011-p5b-next-after-p3b
column6: Selected because stable semantic anchors are a direct prerequisite for persistent cross-surface memory, recurrence analysis, context compilation, and durable object identity. S1 ranked it first, but this selection does not by itself validate S1's judgment.
column7: Stable semantic anchors exist for the declared object types and survive line movement; positional references are demoted to navigation hints and are no longer canonical identity; historical receipts and the sealed DECISION-0011 ordering continue to resolve after repository line positions change.
